request.text:
I set a bowl out for the old goblin woman. Silly. Habit. Somebody ought to mourn her.
<long pause>
Stew's going up the hill by the potful. Don't look at me like that. Hungry's hungry.
<long pause>
<practical, warm, quick but clear Mood: sad.> Bree poured one for the goblin grandmother tonight. Nobody asked why. Nobody drank it.
<long pause>
<practical, warm, quick but clear Mood: happy.> We send stew up the hill now. Bree says hungry is hungry, whatever its ears look like.
<long pause>
<practical, warm, quick but clear Mood: idle.> Folk keep coming in to shout about the mayor. Then they stay for the soup.
<long pause>
You'll want feeding. Sit. I heard what happened on the bridge. I'm not asking, and you're not telling. Not tonight.
<long pause>
Half the town says you've gone soft, and the other half is eating better for it. I know which half I'm in.
